TAB_BRANDING.HINT_FAVICON: The Tachyon icon follows the browser colour scheme. Upload your own, or point at one hosted elsewhere.
TAB_BRANDING.HINT_FAVICON_FILE: SVG is recommended: it is the only format that scales to every size a browser asks for, and the only one that can follow the colour scheme. PNG, ICO, GIF and WebP are accepted but are used at whatever size you upload.
TAB_BRANDING.HINT_LOGO_MODE: The Tachyon logo takes its colour from the theme, so it stays readable on light and dark alike. Choose Custom to use your own artwork, or No logo to show only the loading text.
TAB_BRANDING.HINT_LOGO_LIGHT: Dark artwork, shown on light themes.
TAB_BRANDING.HINT_LOGO_DARK: Light artwork, shown on dark themes. Falls back to the one above when empty.
TAB_BRANDING.ERROR_LOGO_UPLOAD: Upload failed. Only PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG and WebP are accepted.

TAB_CONTACTS.HTML_ALERT_DO_NOT_USE_THIS_DATABASE: Don't use this database type with a large number of active users.

TAB_LOGS.HINT_SYSLOG_IDENT: Name this instance reports to syslog. Set it per instance when more than one runs on a host, and match it in your fail2ban filter.
TAB_LOGS.HINT_PATH: Left empty, logs are written to the data directory.
TAB_LOGS.HINT_FILENAME: Patterns such as {date:Y-m-d}, {user:email} and {user:domain} are replaced. Use "syslog" or "stderr" to write there instead.
TAB_LOGS.LABEL_AUTH_LOGGING: Log failed logins to a separate file
TAB_LOGS.HINT_DEBUG: For development only. Debug logging is verbose and records far more than day to day operation needs.
